tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// sngon 'gro bzhi sbyor gyi khrid dmigs ngag 'don nyung ngur spel ba byang chub snang byed

nor bu'i sgron me bzhugs so// ༄༅// bka' brgyud rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba nyid kyang rgyal sras tshul// snying rje'i rol pa bsam yas pas// gzhan don mdzad pa bla ma'i zhabs// gus pas 'dud do byin gyis rlobs// 'dir dam pa'i chos mtha' dag gi 'jug sgo sngon 'gro bzhi sbyor gyi nyams len khrid dmigs nyung ngur bsdus te ngag 'don tshigs bcad du spel bar bya'o// de la thog mar dal 'byor rnyed dka' sogs blo yul du gsal gdab cing ngag nas/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka'// da res thob 'di don med mi gtong bar// 'jig rten bya ba kun las blo ldog ste// dam chos tshul bzhin sgrub par byin gyis rlobs// dge sdig las 'bras bslu med byed pa po'i// kun gzhi'i sems steng dkar nag 'bras smin phyir// rgyu 'bras blang dor phra zhib byed pa dang*// 'khor bar zhen log skye bar byin gyis rlobs// de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi khrid la skyabs yul gsal gdab pa ni/ rang mdun nam mkhar gser gyi sa gzhi'i dbus// bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho dkar dwangs yangs pa'i dkyil// dpag bsam shing chen rgyas pa'i dbus nyid du// rin chen khri pad nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng*// rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos// rnam pa rdor 'chang rgyal ba'i rgyan bkod rdzogs// brgyud ldan bla ma rab 'byams tshogs kyis bskor// mdun du bcom ldan 'khor lo sdom pa la// dpag yas rgyud sde dkyil 'khor lha yis bskor// g.yas su thub dbang sangs rgyas tshogs bcas dang*// rgyab tu yum chen dam chos glegs bam tshogs// g.yon du spyan ras gzigs dbang tshogs kyi gtsor// byang sems nyan thos dge 'dun chen pos bskor// phyogs mtshams bar snang 'ja' 'od zer gyi klong*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ye shes bsrung ma'i sde// skyabs yul thams cad sprin phung 'khrigs bzhin gsal// bdag dang mtha' yas 'gro ba thams cad kyi// skyabs mgon re sa gzhan med khyed shes blos// byang chub bar du gus pas skyabs su mchi// bla med byang chub sems mchog bskyed par bgyi//

zhes skyabs sems lan gsum/ de nas rang lus kyi bkod pa dpag med sprul nas phyag 'tshal ba'i mos pas/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o// ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o// de bzhin rigs 'gres/ bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku la= bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes phyag stong phrag gcig gam ci nus su 'tshal rjes yid kyi kun tu dmigs pas yan lag bdun pa'i tshul gyis mchod de/ ngag tu tshig bsdus par/ phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*// rjes su yid rangs bskul zhing gsol ba yi// dge ba cung zad bdag gi ci bsags pa// thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir bsngo'o// mdun gyi yi dam tshogs zhing g.yas bskor du// dbus kyi bla ma gtso 'khor la thim ste// mthar yang bla ma 'od zhu rang la bstim// thugs yid dbyer chen klong du mnyam par bzhag/ sdig sgrib sbyong byed rdor sems bsgom bzlas ni/ rang gi spyi bor pad dkar zla ba'i steng*// hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar// rdor dril phyag rgyas yum mchog snyems ma dmar// gri thod 'dzin 'khyud zhabs gnyis rdor skyil bzhugs// gnyis ka'ang rin chen rus rgyan dar dpyangs mdzes// dam ye dbyer med gsal ba'i gnas gsum du// oṃ āḥhūm̐ mtshan thugs srog sngags kyis bskor// de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab sdig sgrib bkrus/ oṃ badzra sa twa sogs yig brgya ci nus bzlas mthar// mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis// rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams chags kun// gnong 'gyod bshags so byang zhing dag mdzad gsol// nyes med dbugs dbyung mdzad thim mnyam par bzhag/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs byed maṇḍal gyi khrid la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rin chen ri rab steng*// sna tshogs padma 'dab bzhi'i lte ba ru// seṅge khri steng bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// bka' brgyud bla ma kun gyi rnam par bskor// 'dab mdun glang po'i khri steng yi dam tshogs// lho phyogs rtas bteg khri la sangs rgyas kun// nub phyogs rma bya'i khri steng dam chos tshogs// byang du mkha' lding khri la spyan ras gzigs// tshogs mchog dge 'dun chen po 'khor bcas kyi// bar mtshams kun khyab ye shes ḍā ki ni// bsrung ma dam can ma lus dgyes bzhugs pa// sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor mchod yul yid kyis dmigs//

de nas yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba ni/ zhing khams rgya mtsho rdul rer rdul rnyed kyi// sangs rgyas sras bcas phyag byar 'os kun la// zhing gi rdul rnyed lus rab btud pa yi// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi// ri rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla lcags rir bcas// rin chen sna bdun gter gyi bum pas legs bkang ste// bdag lus longs spyod snang srid bcas pa kun 'bul na// thugs rje chen pos dgongs te bzhes nas skyabs su gsol// gu ru i daṃ ratna maṇḍa la kaṃ nirya ta yā mi// ka) 'dod khro gti mug dug gis kun blangs pa'i// lus ngag yid gsum nyes spyod kun mthol bshags// legs mdzad kun la yid rangs 'gro ba'i khams// ji bzhin theg mchog chos 'khor bskor bskul zhing*// mya ngan mi 'da' brtan bzhugs gsol bar bgyi// dge ba bla med byang chub chen por bsngo// tshogs zhing rang thim spros med ngang du bzhag// / ༈ bzhi pa byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni// rje btsun rnal 'byor ma yis skur zhes 'debs/ rang nyid bcom ldan bde mchog yab yum skur// gsal ba'i spyi bor khri pad nyi zla'i steng*// rgyal kun ngo bo bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// gzi byin thugs rje'i zil chen dpag med pa// phyag gnyis thabs shes zung 'jug rdor dril 'dzin// rgyan dang cha lugs mtshan dpe yongs rdzogs shing*// bdag la dgyes pa'i zhal ras 'dzum dkar g.yo// ye shes 'od zer mkha' khyab rab 'bar bzhugs// sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// dam chos kun 'dus chos rje rin po che// dge 'dun kun 'dus 'dren mchog rin po che// rtsa gsum kun 'dus gcig chog rgyal po la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes spyan gyis gzigs// mos pa'i bu la da lta byin gyis rlobs// skyabs mgon re sa gzhan na ma mchis pas// rtag par thugs rjes bdag sogs bskyang du gsol// ka)rje btsun bla ma'i sku yi gnas bzhi las// 'od 'phros bdag gi gnas bzhir thim gyur pas// sgrib bzhi dag cing sku bzhi mngon du byas// bla ma rang thim dbyer med mnyam par bzhag

/dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /dpal ldan bla ma 'grub gyur sogs/ bsngo smon ci rigs bya'o// de ltar thun bzhi'i dmigs rim nyung ngu'i tshigs bcad ngag 'don dgos zhes sgro chu 'og nas dad ldan dgos pa rdo rjes bskul ngor/ re zhig rnam g.yeng gi 'gyangs kyang slad kyis bkra shis mthong smon gyi chos gwar/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ bka' brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'gyur med yongs grub dam chos nyi ma'i sdes thun gcig la shar mar sug bris su bstar ba dge bas rang gzhan tshe dang sgrub pa mthar phyin zhing mchog gi dngos grub myur du thob pa'i rgyu gyur cig/ ༈ swa sti/ legs gsungs chos kyi bdud rtsi 'di// mi zad par du spel ba yi// yon sbyor lde 'chang mi pham gyi// par yig zhus dag byed pa'o// rje dpon mi pham bstan 'dzin dang*// gzim dpon rnam rgyal zung gi 'bad// yig bris dbu mdzad mi 'gyur dang*// brkos gsar rgyal mtshan bzang po'o// 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba yis// sems can 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las// grol te bla med byang chub kyi// go 'phang dam pa thob gyur cig// /
